text:
samir: Heads up — invoice preview deltas for tenants on route-hash v2. Preview shows ~2% higher token charges vs final invoice for some tenants. Example tenant t-421, window 2026-03-12 00:00-06:00. Pattern: streaming events missing route_tag enrichment on ingest.

mia: that's the new routing policy rollout, right? we switched hashing + removed the fallback tag yesterday during the canary.

jordan: can you paste sample event ids? I can grep the ingest shard logs and confirm whether enrichment failed or got dropped.

samir: sample ids: ev-8a1b2c, ev-8a1b2d — both show up in preview but end up deduped later.

eng-metering-bot: alert: enrichment-failure-count increased for service "ingest-enricher" from 18 -> 412 between 2026-03-12T00:05Z and 2026-03-12T00:20Z (shard-12).

clare: if route_tag is null downstream, dedupe keys differ and aggregator attributes tokens to separate logical routes. previews do a cheaper pre-enrichment rollup and end up double-counting.

jordan: quick query I ran to confirm nulls:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM billing_events WHERE tenant='t-421' AND route_tag IS NULL AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-12T00:00Z' AND '2026-03-12T06:00Z';
```
returned ~12k rows.

mia: ok that's actionable. two paths: 1) backfill enrichment for null route_tag rows (expensive), 2) change preview aggregator to fallback to client_route when route_tag missing (lower cost short-term).

samir: backfill estimate ~ $1.2k compute, plus risk window for reprocessing. Changing preview aggregator is lower risk but might hide the underlying issue. We should do both: patch preview first, schedule backfill later.

clare: agree. Also console/UI needs to surface when a preview includes fallbacked enrichment so billing ops don't misinterpret numbers. add an "incomplete enrichment" badge on invoice preview.

jordan: I'll implement the aggregator fallback as a canary on preview cluster and gate it behind feature-flag `preview_enrichment_fallback`. Will open PR and include telemetry.

samir: owners: jordan -> preview patch + canary, mia -> backfill plan + cost approval with finance, clare -> console flag/UX and dashboard marker.

jordan: created PR #4182 with tests and telemetry hooks. Canary deploy scheduled 2026-03-12T10:00Z.

mia: filing billing ops ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-2217 with samples and cost estimate. tagging finance for approval.

clare: mock for console badge and checkbox to "Show enriched-only totals" in figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123 (mock v2).

samir: metrics to add: 1) preview_vs_final_delta (percent) 2) enrichment_null_rate (percent of events with null route_tag). Alert when preview_vs_final_delta > 1% sustained for 30m.

eng-metering-bot: note: enrichment_null_rate metric will be emitted after PR #4182 merges and canary confirms zero regressions.

samir: thanks all — please post rollout notes after canary. cc @release-bot for deploy window :thumbsup:
